title: Bài thi thử nói lớp 8
topics: Leisure Time · Life in the Countryside · Teenagers
note: Bài thi thử một lần, KHÁC dạng bài kiểm tra nghiên cứu: không tiếng bíp, không giới hạn thời gian, học sinh tự bấm khi sẵn sàng. Nhóm soạn theo Unit 1–3, chưa thầy cô duyệt. Không trùng đề A/B (test tự động kiểm tra).

questions.text: How do you usually spend your Sunday afternoon?
Have you ever stayed in a village for a few days?
What do you like doing with your classmates after school?
Which school club have you joined or would you like to join?
Do you prefer staying at home or going out at weekends? Why?
Would you like to live in a village when you grow up? Why or why not?
Do you think teenagers have too much homework? Why?
What is the best thing about being a teenager? Why?
Your cousin from the city is visiting your grandparents' village. Suggest two things to do there.
A new student in your class looks lonely at break time. What would you do?
